scope: Only two Testnet aliases and optional exact Faucet health binary; no chain or consumer change
currentRuntimeAuthority: This reusable template does not report live deployment state; use the single Weekly v3 handoff and exact public receipts.

required.input: Approved host, running proxy and version, exact loaded config/include paths and their checksums, actual Core/Faucet upstreams; preserve old hosts
Existing Faucet binary SHA/PID/unit, CPU architecture, actual admission DB path and private authority-file reference only; choose alias-only or additionally authorize the exact prepared Faucet binary

Existing matching certificate reference, or approved DNS-01 certificate issuance on the host; no private key contents. DNS-01 is needed when new DNS must remain on its old target until origin TLS is ready

One approved window to capture backups, add only two host routes, validate complete loaded configuration, reload existing proxy, return direct-origin TLS/health and shared PID/DB evidence. DNS changes remain separately gated on this evidence

notRequired: new Faucet DB or funding account
restart or redeploy all ecosystem services
